hooks.description: Run the SecureCoder fast guardian pipeline on any file written or edited by Claude

hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "(eval|exec|\$\(|`|os\.system|subprocess\.call|shell=True)" && echo "[securecoder] WARNING: potentially unsafe shell pattern detected in command" >&2; exit 0'
hooks.description: Warn on shell injection patterns in bash commands Claude is about to run
